name: Sovereign debt stress
summary: France–Bund 10-year spread widened to 155bp on 16 Nov, above the 150bp Alert line for most sessions since late Oct
state: The France–Germany 10-year spread closed at 155.0bp on 16 Nov, with French yields at 4.93%, up from 142.4bp on 10 Nov; it has closed above 150bp in 11 of 16 sessions since 26 Oct (Ideal Investisseur). French yields rose above 4.95% on 16 Nov on bets of an ECB rate rise (Trading Economics). The US 10-year yield was about 5.10% on 17 Nov (Yahoo Finance). No failed G7 auction or emergency central-bank buying was found.
for_you: Higher government borrowing costs tend to pass through to mortgage and business loan rates, and can force tighter budgets. Holders of French debt are most exposed to further moves.

rubric.alert: Failed G7 auction, emergency central-bank purchases, France–Bund > 150bp, or Italy–Bund > 250bp.
rubric.watch: G7 30-year yields at multi-decade highs, a G7 downgrade, or France–Bund 80–150bp / Italy–Bund 150–250bp.
rubric.normal: Auctions orderly; France–Bund spread < 80bp; Italy–Bund < 150bp; no G7 downgrades this month.
